content:
maria: starting a low-volume canary for v2-quant4-lattice — shadowed traffic for 12h then 2% live progressive ramp. need firm gating rules for automatic fallback. tl;dr: cost down ~2.7x in perf bench, p95 latency +10ms, but we saw a small uptick in hallucination signals in offline eval. thoughts?

tom: can you paste the baseline vs canary metrics? numbers make it easier. :eyes:

maria: baseline (v2fp16): concordance 92.1%, hallucination_rate 0.9%, latency_p95 190ms
canary (v2-quant4-lattice): concordance 89.8%, hallucination_rate 1.5%, latency_p95 202ms
notes: concordance is aggregated exact-match-like metric on our prod eval set, hallucination_rate is flagged by our hallucination-detector heuristics, sample size ~7k for the shadow window so far.

rahul: concordance drop ~= 2.3 pts absolute — that's non-trivial. i'd avoid hard binary thresholds without smoothing. propose: require breach sustained for 15min and minimum 500 requests in window before auto-fallback. also use Bayesian posterior on difference rather than simple p-value.

sarah: +1 to smoothing. Also we should separate behavior by slice: long-form doc summarization can tolerate some latency but is sensitive to hallucination. short prompts are latency-critical. gating should be slice-aware.

maria: agreed on slice-aware. proposed canary config (internal canary service):
```json
{"canary_name":"v2-q4-lattice-2pct","traffic_percent":2,"slices":["short","long"],"rules":[{"metric":"concordance","max_drop_abs":1.5,"min_duration_sec":900},{"metric":"hallucination_rate","max_increase_abs":0.5,"min_duration_sec":900},{"metric":"latency_p95","max_increase_ms":75,"min_duration_sec":300}],"auto_fallback":true,"min_requests":500}
```
this is conservative for concordance (1.5pt) and hallucination (+0.5%). latency allowed to spike more briefly.

tom: looks reasonable. can we add a statistical check: require 95% credible interval for concordance drop > threshold before triggering? avoids flapping.

rahul: yes — implement bootstrap CI over last N requests. also add dampening: if fallback triggered, keep the model pinned out for at least 30min before allowing re-promote attempt.

eval-bot: canary summary after 2h shadow + 1h at 2% live (sample counts: short=1.2k, long=320):
- concordance: baseline 92.1% vs canary 90.9% (delta -1.2 abs)
- hallucination_rate: baseline 0.9% vs canary 1.6% (delta +0.7 abs)
- latency_p95: baseline 190ms vs canary 202ms (+12ms)
- win_rate (preference tests): 47.8% canary / 52.2% baseline (two-sided p=0.18)
notes: long slice is ~worse: concordance drop -2.6pts and hallucinations +1.1pt.

maria: thanks — those long-slice numbers push me to tighten long-slice hallucination threshold to +0.4 abs and require no concordance drop >1.0 abs on long-slice. update config:
```json
{"slices":{"short":{"concordance_drop_max":1.5,"hallucination_increase_max":0.6},"long":{"concordance_drop_max":1.0,"hallucination_increase_max":0.4}},"sustain_sec":900,"min_requests":500,"fallback_cooldown_sec":1800}
```

sarah: also flag for manual review if win_rate <48% AND hallucination_increase >0.5 (even if not auto-fallback) — ops team wants to triage before any blind rollout.

tom: agree. can we wire a scoreboard tile (console) that shows per-slice delta + CI and an auto-fallback event log? i can add a dashboard PR.

rahul: one more: for promotion we should require no metric regression for 24h at 5% traffic after canary before full promote. prevents short-term noise pushing it through.

maria: plan: deploy the updated canary config, start 12h shadow, then 2% ramp. enable bootstrap CI checks + sustain windows + slice-specific thresholds + fallback cooldown. if stats breach, auto-fallback triggers and ops gets paged for manual review. i'll post the updated canary id and dashboard link after deploy. :thumbsup:

eval-bot: canary config applied (id: canary-1719904321-q4l). monitoring hooks live.

maria: excellent — thanks all. we'll reconvene on results at EOD and decide whether to widen shadow or abort. :eyes:
